## Purpose

Combine the outputs of pre-processing steps 01–04 into one versioned data set
that all analysis steps read: the log2-transformed metabolite matrix, the cell
line table with tissue, batch and modelling flags, the ion table, and the
mutation and copy-number status.

## Inputs

- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/01_injections.rds`, `01_lines.rds`, `02_cell_lines.tsv`, `03_features.rds`, `04_depmap_models.tsv`, `04_mutation_status.tsv`, `04_homozygous_deletions.tsv`, `04_copy_number.rds`
- culture batch per injection (`config.yml: shorthouse.batch_mapping`, local only)
- `config.yml`: lines excluded from all analyses

## Methods

Intensities were averaged per cell line (step 01). Values <= 0 (0.15 % of the
values) were considered below the detection limit and replaced by half of the
minimum positive value of the respective metabolite (Wei et al., 2018) using
MetaProViz, followed by log2 transformation (decision D7). Each line was
assigned the culture batch in which most of its injections were measured
(D8). Lines were used in mutation models only if they are malignant (D12), have
a tissue label and are matched to DepMap (D16). For every ion, the number of
imputed values and the ratio of the variance between line means to the mean
variance within lines (log2 scale) are recorded.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/plotting.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/transform.R"))
config <- load_config()
raw_dir <- uc_dir(config, "raw")
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
output_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "05_analysis_dataset")

inputs <- c(
    injections = file.path(derived_dir, "01_injections.rds"),
    lines = file.path(derived_dir, "01_lines.rds"),
    cell_lines = file.path(derived_dir, "02_cell_lines.tsv"),
    features = file.path(derived_dir, "03_features.rds"),
    depmap_models = file.path(derived_dir, "04_depmap_models.tsv"),
    mutation_status = file.path(derived_dir, "04_mutation_status.tsv"),
    deletions = file.path(derived_dir, "04_homozygous_deletions.tsv"),
    copy_number = file.path(derived_dir, "04_copy_number.rds"),
    batch_mapping = file.path(raw_dir, config$shorthouse$batch_mapping)
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(inputs)))

injection_data <- readRDS(inputs[["injections"]])
line_data <- readRDS(inputs[["lines"]])
cell_lines <- readr::read_tsv(inputs[["cell_lines"]], show_col_types = FALSE)
features <- readRDS(inputs[["features"]])
depmap_models <- readr::read_tsv(inputs[["depmap_models"]], show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Metabolite matrix

```{r matrix}
# mean intensity per line (step 01); values <= 0 -> half-minimum -> log2 (D7)
raw <- line_data$intensities
log2_values <- log2_half_minimum(raw)
imputed <- raw <= 0
c(lines = nrow(log2_values), ions = ncol(log2_values), imputed_values = sum(imputed))
preview_table(round(log2_values, 3), rows = 50, cols = 20, caption = "log2 intensities, lines × ions")
```

## Cell lines

```{r batch}
# culture batch per injection (Batch6A -> Batch6), majority batch per line (D8)
batch_of_injection <- readr::read_csv(inputs[["batch_mapping"]], show_col_types = FALSE,
                                      name_repair = "unique_quiet") %>%
    transmute(injection_id = as.character(dsIdx),
              batch = sub("[A-Za-z]$", "", sub("_.*$", "", dsPert)))
stopifnot(all(injection_data$injections$injection_id %in% batch_of_injection$injection_id))

batch_per_line <- injection_data$injections %>%
    left_join(batch_of_injection, by = "injection_id") %>%
    count(line, batch) %>%
    group_by(line) %>%
    summarise(
        n_batches = n(),
        batch = batch[which.max(n)],
        .groups = "drop"
    )
count(batch_per_line, n_batches)
```

```{r lines}
# lines excluded from all analyses (config.yml), with the reason
excluded <- tibble(line = names(config$analysis$exclude_lines),
                   exclusion_reason = unlist(config$analysis$exclude_lines))

lines <- cell_lines %>%
    select(line, member_names, accession, cellosaurus_name, accession_source, engineered,
           tissue, general_site, tissue_note, n_injections) %>%
    left_join(batch_per_line, by = "line") %>%
    left_join(select(depmap_models, line, ModelID, OncotreeLineage), by = "line") %>%
    left_join(excluded, by = "line") %>%
    mutate(
        has_depmap = !is.na(ModelID),
        # a matched model can lack mutation calls (NCI-H1755 in 24Q4, audit/08); such a
        # line would otherwise read as wild type for every gene
        has_mutation_calls = line %in% readr::read_tsv(inputs[["mutation_status"]], show_col_types = FALSE)$line,
        has_copy_number = line %in% rownames(readRDS(inputs[["copy_number"]])),
        # lines used in mutation models (D12, D16, D24)
        in_models = is.na(exclusion_reason) & !engineered & tissue != "Unknown" & has_depmap & has_mutation_calls
    ) %>%
    slice(match(rownames(log2_values), line))
stopifnot(identical(lines$line, rownames(log2_values)))

c(lines = nrow(lines), in_models = sum(lines$in_models))
lines %>%
    filter(!in_models) %>%
    transmute(line, tissue, engineered, has_depmap, has_mutation_calls, exclusion_reason) %>%
    preview_table(caption = "Lines not used in mutation models")
count(filter(lines, in_models), tissue, sort = TRUE)
preview_table(lines, caption = "Cell line table")
```

## Ions

```{r ions}
# line-specific signal per ion: variance between line means / mean variance
# within lines, both on the log2 scale (audit/01, section 5)
X <- log2_half_minimum(injection_data$intensities)
line_of <- injection_data$injections$line[match(rownames(X), injection_data$injections$injection_id)]
within <- apply(X, 2, function(v) mean(tapply(v, line_of, var)))
line_means <- rowsum(X, line_of) / as.vector(table(line_of)[rownames(rowsum(X, line_of))])
between <- apply(line_means, 2, var)

ions <- features %>%
    mutate(
        n_imputed = colSums(imputed)[feature_id],
        has_imputed_values = n_imputed > 0,
        replicate_signal_ratio = (between / within)[feature_id]
    ) %>%
    slice(match(colnames(log2_values), feature_id))
stopifnot(identical(ions$feature_id, colnames(log2_values)))
c(ions = nrow(ions), with_imputed_values = sum(ions$has_imputed_values))
preview_table(ions, caption = "Ion table")
```

## Outputs

```{r save}
analysis_data <- list(
    log2 = log2_values,                  # lines × ions, model scale
    raw = raw,                           # lines × ions, published scale (means)
    lines = lines,
    ions = ions,
    mutation_status = readr::read_tsv(inputs[["mutation_status"]], show_col_types = FALSE),
    homozygous_deletions = readr::read_tsv(inputs[["deletions"]], show_col_types = FALSE),
    copy_number = readRDS(inputs[["copy_number"]])
)
out <- c(analysis_data = file.path(derived_dir, "shorthouse_analysis_v1.rds"))
saveRDS(analysis_data, out[["analysis_data"]])
write_manifest(out, inputs, file.path(derived_dir, "05_manifest.json"),
               extra = list(exclude_lines = config$analysis$exclude_lines))
```

## Interpretation

The data set holds all 175 lines and 1096 ions; lines that are excluded,
engineered, without tissue, without DepMap data or without DepMap mutation
calls are kept but flagged
(`in_models = FALSE`). All analysis steps read only this file.
